column2: All used equipment should be made of some toxin, odor, odor or taste-nonproducing substance. Such
equipment and tools should be made of non-absorbent and stainless materials and they should be made
of materials that are resistant to continuous cleaning and disinfection. There should be smooth surfaces
free of gaps and fine openings. Avoid using wood and other materials that are not easily cleaned and
disinfect able and can only be used when they are not clearly a source of combustion.
All equipment and tools should be easily cleaned and disinfected to prevent the risk.
